title: Juice N Power Sour Apple Power 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Sour Apple Power from Juice N Power is candy apple flavour with real character. The mouth-watering hard candy apple taste brings a rush of sharp, sour satisfaction that ends with a deliciously sweet and smooth exhale. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks.
